details: Bitcoin surged over 3%, surpassing $79,000, driven by President Trump's optimistic comments about a potential US-Iran agreement, which also led to a dip in oil prices. Simultaneously, progress on the US Senate's Clarity Act, a significant cryptocurrency regulation bill, contributed to the positive market sentiment. Investors are also closely monitoring the Federal Reserve's upcoming interest rate decision.
title: Bitcoin Rallies on US-Iran Deal Hopes, US Crypto Bill Progress

details: Bitcoin remains volatile, hovering around $78,000, as the US Senate moves towards a cloture vote on the Clarity Act, a significant cryptocurrency regulation bill. Polymarket odds for the bill's passage have fallen, weighing on crypto sentiment. This legislative uncertainty coincides with elevated broader crypto market volatility and anticipation of the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision later this week, influenced by rising Treasury yields and oil prices.
title: Bitcoin Volatile Ahead of US Crypto Bill Vote, Fed Meeting

details: Escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, including renewed US-Iran conflicts and Houthi attacks impacting key shipping lanes, have driven oil prices higher, with Brent crude reaching approximately $107 per barrel. This surge in energy costs exacerbates inflation risks and, coupled with rising US 10-year Treasury yields hitting 5.03% (a level not seen since 2007), creates a bearish sentiment for broader financial markets and risk assets.
title: M. East Tensions & Rising Oil Prices Weigh on Markets
